title: Full Moon in Aries
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Aries / Libra axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates courage, direct action, self-trust, and clean beginnings through the Aries side of the axis, while the Sun in Libra asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: bulldozing without checking direction, reacting before listening, or confusing urgency with truth
integration: commanding your life without making every room a battlefield

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc reveals where compromise crossed into self-betrayal.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Aries / Libra balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Mars kamea, red or orange candle, bloodstone or garnet, basil, water, incense, and a simple symbol of courage.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Aries can be embodied without rejecting Libra.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Aries, and what balance with Libra is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Aries Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
